nodes.label: Phase 9 — Deadline + Progress Report + Yellow Flag

nodes.label: Jomlink Build Documentation (README)
nodes.rationale: Phased build plan: build one phase at a time, read the phase doc before starting, and mark a phase complete in 00-project-plan.md only once its Definition of Done is met. The JOMLINK PLATFORM BLUEPRINT v1.md at the workspace root remains the product source of truth.

nodes.label: Transaction Engine (Funding / Escrow / Fees / Refunds / Payouts)
nodes.norm_label: transaction engine (funding / escrow / fees / refunds / payouts)

nodes.label: 10% Refundable Posting Deposit (less RM10 listing fee)
nodes.rationale: Auto-deducted from the Seeker wallet at post time so posting carries skin in the game; refundable less a flat RM10 non-refundable listing fee if cancelled before a Linker is selected, and consumed once a Linker is selected. A Seeker cannot post without sufficient credit.
nodes.norm_label: 10% refundable posting deposit (less rm10 listing fee)

nodes.label: Full Reward Settlement into Escrow at Linker Acceptance
nodes.rationale: The reward is deliberately NOT charged at posting to avoid locking Seeker funds early; instead the Seeker must have full settlement available when accepting a Linker's submission, at which point the reward is deducted and held in escrow until verified completion.
nodes.norm_label: full reward settlement into escrow at linker acceptance

nodes.label: Double-Entry Transaction Ledger
nodes.rationale: Double-entry debit/credit entries are mandated so all money movement is traceable and auditable (transaction_ledger).

nodes.label: Connection Workflow (appointment → acknowledgement → evidence → completion)
nodes.rationale: The Seeker must acknowledge the proposed connection before sensitive data flows; the deliverable must be defined (intro, meeting, executive meeting, site visit) and the evidence requirement depends on the opportunity category.

nodes.label: Deadline Setting (Linker requests → Seeker accepts/rejects)
nodes.rationale: Deadline setting is a distinct, timestamped step separate from the negotiation trail (blueprint §5.6.1) so the commitment is unambiguous and attributable. After the Seeker accepts the Linker, the Linker requests the deadline; the Seeker accepting makes it official (task → IN_PROGRESS), while rejecting or requesting a change reopens terms for negotiation (§5.6). No deadline is official until accepted.

nodes.label: Linker Yellow Flag (missed commitment)
nodes.rationale: A yellow flag marks a Linker who set a deadline but could not deliver by it. It is intentionally a commitment signal, NOT a penalty, and does not by itself release the reward — only a §5.13 failure does. It clears automatically on on-time delivery or an accepted extension, feeds the Linker Performance Record and Reputation, and repeated flags are a fraud/abuse signal.

nodes.label: Progress Report Thread
nodes.rationale: Opens when the Seeker accepts the deadline and stays open until the deadline ends (closes at COMPLETED / FAILED / EXPIRED / DISPUTED). The Linker posts the reports (reporting obligation) and both Linker and Seeker comment. Extension requests are raised through the thread so the reason and both parties' positions are captured. Nothing in the thread is ever destroyed — it is the evidence of record for later disputes (§9.11.1).

nodes.label: Comment Editing with Immutable Revision History
nodes.rationale: Either party may edit their own comment, but every edit preserves the previous version as update history visible to both parties and to admin. Preserving the prior version is what makes the thread usable as dispute evidence: a party cannot rely on a comment's current wording alone.
nodes.norm_label: comment editing with immutable revision history

nodes.label: Reputation Metrics (success rate, avg rating, deadlines met/missed, yellow flags)
nodes.norm_label: reputation metrics (success rate, avg rating, deadlines met/missed, yellow flags)

nodes.label: Failed Opportunity (linker did not complete within deadline, no valid extension)
nodes.norm_label: failed opportunity (linker did not complete within deadline, no valid extension)

nodes.label: Status Progression IN_PROGRESS → APPOINTMENT_SCHEDULED → AWAITING_VERIFICATION → COMPLETED
nodes.norm_label: status progression in_progress → appointment_scheduled → awaiting_verification → completed

nodes.label: Role-Based Admin System (Super, Operations, KYC, Finance, Dispute, Compliance, Support)
nodes.rationale: RBAC exists so there is no unrestricted internal access; views are role-scoped. Government category is restricted with no guaranteed approvals or tenders. Audit actions are tamper-resistant and retained.
nodes.norm_label: role-based admin system (super, operations, kyc, finance, dispute, compliance, support)

nodes.label: Dispute Workflow (raise → payment hold → review → resolution)
nodes.norm_label: dispute workflow (raise → payment hold → review → resolution)

nodes.label: Dispute Evidence of Record
nodes.rationale: When resolving a dispute the administrator must be able to reconstruct what was claimed, by whom, and when — not just read a message's current text. The screen must surface the deadline record (requested date, timestamp, accept/reject), the progress report thread in order, all comments with expandable prior versions (author + edit timestamp), and the yellow-flag record. Nothing is ever hard-deleted, every entry is immutable once written, timestamped and attributed, and the record may be relied upon in place of free-text messages to establish the state of work at a given date.

nodes.label: KYC Records (simplified MVP: status + badge only)
nodes.rationale: KYC is deliberately simplified for the MVP (status + badge only) to ship fast; liveness/selfie, expiry tracking and automated verification providers are deferred to production hardening. Identity documents go to a PRIVATE kyc-documents bucket addressed by path only and read server-side via the service-role client — never publicly served — so the service-role key never leaves the server.

nodes.label: MVP Polish Phase (accessibility WCAG AA, responsive, SEO, public info pages)
nodes.rationale: Deliberately framed as the final MVP polish phase so that after it the platform is MVP-complete and ready for a controlled market pilot in Malaysia (MYR); mobile apps, team accounts, advanced analytics and multi-currency are deferred.

nodes.label: Phase 9 — Deadline Setting + Progress Report Thread + Yellow Flag
nodes.rationale: Phase 9 was split out of Phase 6 because the deadline + progress-thread work remains not-started while Phase 6's other connection/trust deliverables are done; it extends Phase 4 (proposals/negotiation) and Phase 7 (admin disputes). Automated nudges/reminders, fraud risk scoring that consumes flags, and automated evidence verification are explicitly out of scope for later phases.
